paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for different activation functions. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1500, with a tick label interval of 250. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", also has a linear scale, ranging from 45 to 55, with a tick label interval of 5. Three lines are plotted: "Squared Exponential" in dark blue with a solid line and circle markers, "Tanh" in blue with a solid line and circle markers, and "ELU" in light blue with a solid line and circle markers, alongside a dashed pink line representing "LLaMA-2-chat-7B". The "Squared Exponential" line starts at around 52 at 0 demonstrations and increases to approximately 56 at 1000 demonstrations, remaining steady thereafter. The "Tanh" line begins at around 47 at 0 demonstrations and gradually rises to about 48.5 at 250 demonstrations, remaining relatively stable until 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" line commences at roughly 46.5 at 0 demonstrations and increases to approximately 48 at 250 demonstrations, then remains steady. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is constant at around 44 across the entire range of demonstrations.
